summary: The input always contains exactly three bounded side lengths, so every legal call has the same fixed amount of sorting, validation, and trigonometric work and cannot support meaningful scaling tiers.

workload_bound.source_constraint: The source contract fixes sides.length at exactly 3.

replacement_checks.evidence: Sorting three values, checking one triangle inequality, and evaluating at most three angle formulas are all fixed-size operations independent of the side magnitudes.

The certificate regression compares both packaged sources with an independent Heron-and-atan2 oracle over exhaustive small triples, deterministic random full-range triples, all permutations, authored cases, and legal boundary families.
